examples.title: Example 1: Implementing Custom Gesture Judgment
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement custom judgment for long press, swipe, and pan gestures using onGestureJudgeBegin. Starting from API version 21, axisPinch property of BaseEvent can be used to obtain the two-finger pinch scale ratio.

examples.title: Example 2: Implementing Custom Area Gesture Judgment
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use onGestureJudgeBegin to determine whether to respond to long press and pan gestures based on the area.

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing Real-time Monitoring of Active Touch Points in Gestures
examples.description: This example demonstrates real-time monitoring of active touch points participating in gestures, including their count, IDs, and coordinates, by configuring fingerInfos.
